name: FastAPI concurrency and request lifecycle

preflight.scope: One-hour metrics snapshot during Task 6 preflight. Limits are not guaranteed dedicated capacity.
preflight.db_budget: Task 5 budget retained: 6 sockets steady state, 12 during two-worker deployment overlap; application allocation 40 out of 60 after reserve 20.

implementation.admission: 64 ordinary in-flight requests per worker; bulk uploads/imports/reports have a sub-limit of 4; SSE has a separate limit of 256. No application admission queue; excess receives private 503 with Retry-After=1. These are conservative limits, not measured learner capacity.
implementation.blocking_work: At most two submitted CPU jobs and four storage jobs per worker; waiting for a work slot is bounded to one second. Jobs retain their slot until the underlying thread actually completes, including after an HTTP waiter is cancelled.
off_loop: Content package and Reading bundle validation
Storage client initialization and object operations
implementation.request_timeouts: Body receipt has a total 30-second bound. Ordinary safe reads have a 30-second response-start bound, removed once streaming begins. Authentication callbacks and the frequent session handshake retain their provider/database bounds instead of a duplicate request timer. Mutations are not arbitrarily cancelled after body receipt; database/provider and admission limits remain active.
implementation.storage_socket_bounds: Connect 5 seconds, read idle 10 seconds, standard retries with two total attempts. A socket idle timeout is not a total large-transfer deadline; media work remains Task 9.
implementation.probes: Liveness remains available. Readiness fails during drain or ordinary admission exhaustion, has at most two concurrent probes and a five-second deadline, and retains existing database/rate-table/frontend checks.
implementation.shutdown: Uvicorn request grace 30 seconds; blocking-work drain 5 seconds; listener close 5 seconds; pool close 10 seconds with termination on failure/cancellation. One explicit worker prevents WEB_CONCURRENCY from multiplying the database budget.
implementation.interface: Latest upstream Day/Night backgrounds and gradients preserved. Only the profile placeholder initial inherits the existing black gradient-label colour. No layout/navigation/learning/module-name changes.

shutdown_wire_probe.scope: Synthetic local in-flight work over real TCP and the actual launcher; no academic/database or capacity claim.

performance.method: One current ASGI application and embedded PostgreSQL fixture, one persistent TestClient lifespan/event loop, alternating requests with and without RequestBudget; four isolated learners, 90 warmup pairs and 500 retained pairs per scenario. Actual per-user Dictionary quota is retained.
performance.scope: Incremental ordinary request-admission overhead. Local sequential measurements do not establish production latency, throughput or 200/500/1000-user readiness.
retained_diagnostics: Separate-process main/current samples and earlier smaller paired samples exceeded the 10% p95 threshold; they are retained in work logs, not reported as passing.
The context-free TestClient created a new portal for every request. The final paired fixture uses one persistent lifespan, matching the server model.
A previous paired fixture exceeded the real Dictionary quota; sample identity rotation preserves the quota without disabling limits.
The session handshake now uses its existing database bounds without a duplicate request timer; bodyless GET/HEAD does not allocate a body-receipt timer.
